messages:
Maya R.: Quick heads-up — during NorthBay onboarding call just now we logged three product asks that sound like renewal risk if not addressed. Can we do a fast triage? :eyes:
Tony C.: sending the raw notes now. TL;DR: per-route cost visibility, embedding freshness, and a one-click rollback for model pinning.
Liam P.: got it. can you paste the excerpts?
Maya R.: pasted below:
```
1) "We need per-route cost breakdown in the console — finance wants it before renewal."
2) "Embeddings drift; need a way to refresh index or see staleness scores."
3) "When a rollout breaks we need a rollback button to previous model with traffic split preserved."
```
Anya K.: thanks. first pass: (1) is visibility + billing mapping (medium effort UI + backend), (2) is an embeddings ops feature (requires index refresh API + monitor), (3) is a deploy UX improvement (small UI + rollback infra safety checks).
Priya S.: flagging that (1) has high renewal impact for NorthBay specifically — their finance team requested it twice. moving to high priority if we want to keep momentum.
Tony C.: NorthBay asked for an ETA in next 2 weeks. they said they'd reconsider dedicated capacity if this isn't sorted.
Liam P.: can we do a mitigant: add a temporary per-route export CSV from the console that maps tokens->route->cost? quick win maybe 3-4 dev days.
Anya K.: agree. quick export as a stopgap. then schedule proper per-route UI in the roadmap.
Maya R.: actionable plan?
Tony C.: propose:
- short-term: export CSV + a one-pager to share with NorthBay (owner: Liam) — target EOD next Friday
- mid-term: per-route billing UI (PM + Eng scoping) — target Q2 sprint
- embeddings: add manual index refresh endpoint + alert for staleness > threshold (owner: Anya) — target 3 weeks
- rollback: safety-first small UX change to show "Rollback to previous model" (owner: Priya) — target 2 weeks
Liam P.: I can own CSV export. will need a small schema from billing team — @Priya can you loop them in?
Priya S.: looping in billing.yml (cc @billing-team). also adding customer note for renewals doc.
Maya R.: and please draft a short message we can send to NorthBay summarizing plan + timelines. I'll own comms.
Tony C.: cool. I'll add these as tickets and tag with renewal:high + onboard:sprint.
cs-bot: Created ticket #CS-4871 (per-route-export) and #ENG-9223 (embeddings-refresh) :white_check_mark:
Maya R.: thanks all. let's sync in tomorrow's 10am CS huddle for any blockers. :thumbsup:
